title: Bands before Jack Carey: Robichaux, Joe Howard, Bob Lyons, Sam Morgan
summary: Vincent's earlier jobs: John Robichaux's band, Joe Howard, Bob Lyons (crooked), Sam Morgan, then Ernest Poirier; Maurice Durand later moved to California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Big George Williams. Yeah. I hear him in the street with Big George.
He plays saxophone with him. Yeah.

Maurice. Yeah. And I know you ought to have Maurice Duran, eh? Yeah, he's in California now. Yeah. He played with us a good while too, Maurice. Which band? Who Maurice worked with out there? Huh? Who you worked with in California, Maurice? No, he worked some kind of factory, Rick Broom or something. You got me? Yeah, and he's doing stuff out there. He worked playing music. But, see in California, they don't let you play that long old one job like you do here. Everybody got to get a break out there, you know? They give you about six months, something like that, and later, get another union band, you see? That's why I paid them after they come back down there, you see? They went up there for two years, you see? They went up there for four months. They went up there for four months.
